#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc (4 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Same setup as 'toydrift_periodic_slab_pcg', but solving the per-step guiding-center Poisson problem with PETScSolver (KSP=cg, PC=gamg) instead."
echo "Physics problem: Electrostatic E x B drift of a single ion species in a periodic slab."
echo "Struphy model used: ToyDrift"
echo "Case directory: /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T101817Z-555faf86/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T101817Z-555faf86/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/sim_03"
cp "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab/params_periodic_slab_petsc.py" "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T101817Z-555faf86/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/parameters.py"

echo "Running toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc with 4 MPI ranks"
cd "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T101817Z-555faf86/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc"
mpirun -n 4 /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/python /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab/params_periodic_slab_petsc.py --id 3 > "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T101817Z-555faf86/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/sim_03/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc (4 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
